preconditions.expression: isinstance(x, str) and len(x) >= 1 and len(x) <= 32000
preconditions.description: Input x is a non-empty string with length between 1 and 32000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == all((x.count('{') == x.count('}')) and (x.count('(') == x.count(')')) and (x.count('[') == x.count(']')))
postconditions.description: The output is true if and only if the counts of each type of opening and closing bracket ({,}, (,), [,]) are equal in x.

postconditions.description: The output is true if and only if the brackets in x are balanced in terms of nesting and ordering, meaning no closing bracket appears before its corresponding opening bracket.
